Composition rights
Underlying composition is out of copyright where the ordinary life-plus-70 term applies. Inferred, not documented

Rachmaninoff died in 1943. This is a territorial term calculation, not worldwide clearance or a statement about an unidentified modern performing edition.

[5] [6]
Recording rights
Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported, applied explicitly to the recording by La Pianista. Documented

The page has separate notices for recording and composition. CC BY 3.0 governs this performance; the composition’s public-domain notice is not substituted for the recording licence.
